name: Direct Debit Context 1
definition: Element containing all information needed for a direct debit.

DebtorAccount.name: Debtor Account
DebtorAccount.definition: Information related to the debtor's account.

ProtectedDebtorAccount.name: Protected Debtor Account
ProtectedDebtorAccount.definition: Secured information related to the debtor's account.

CreditorAccount.name: Creditor Account
CreditorAccount.definition: Information related to the creditor's account.

ProtectedCreditorAccount.name: Protected Creditor Account
ProtectedCreditorAccount.definition: Secured information related to the creditor's account.

MandateRelatedInformation.name: Mandate Related Information
MandateRelatedInformation.definition: Provides further details of the mandate signed between the creditor and the debtor.
